offering_description.value: Sells fixed and indexed annuities and life insurance to individuals planning for retirement and protection. Products are sold through independent agents, banks and broker-dealers, and the company earns investment income on the funds it manages for policyholders.

primary_products.value: fixed indexed annuities; fixed annuities; indexed universal life insurance; term life insurance

customer_segment.value: B2C: individuals buying retirement income products and life insurance coverage

revenue_model.value: interest or premiums: investment income on policyholder funds and insurance premiums on life policies; transaction or usage fees: policy charges and surrender fees on annuity and life contracts
revenue_model.category: interest or premiums; transaction or usage fees

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: takes in premiums and deposits from individuals, invests them, and pays benefits to policyholders

geography_served.value: US national: licensed in most US states, excluding New York

specialization.value: related lines: fixed and indexed annuities and life insurance sold to the same retirement-focused customers

distribution_channels.value: agents / brokers: independent marketing organizations and independent insurance agents; partners / resellers: banks and broker-dealers offering annuities to their clients

regulatory_exposure.value: high: state insurance departments license and approve the company's products and monitor its solvency
